$comment: MODE = dark. Neutrals only. This is Confetti's dark look and the fallback for any theme that doesn't bring its own — an EDITORIAL GRAY: neutral graphite surfaces with a slight cool cast, cool off-white text, and the brand red left as the one warm thing on the page. Light mode is warm cream paper; the two modes are deliberately different temperatures rather than one being a tinted copy of the other. Subtle accent tints deepen (X.700) so the light foreground reads on them; the hover shadow repoints to chalk, since a dark shadow on a dark surface reads as nothing. Emitted under [data-mode='dark'].

backdrop.comment: recessed mat — the deepest graphite, below page

on-bold.comment: bold hues stay light in dark mode, so the deepest graphite reads on them

on-subtle.comment: subtle tints are deep in dark mode — needs the light foreground

button-lift.comment: button hover shadow — separate from card so a theme can drop or swap it
